summary: Created one structural silver-deficit idea. A sixth annual deficit and above-ground inventory draw are supported, but current evidence also shows PV thrifting, substitution, increased recycling, and investment-flow sensitivity. No unverified ticker association, relationship, or strategy was created.

evidence.claim: The survey projects a sixth annual deficit and a cumulative 2021-2026 deficit of 762.1 million ounces while expecting the imbalance to moderate.
The outlook forecasts a 67-million-ounce deficit and 20% physical-investment growth, alongside 2% lower industrial fabrication, PV thrifting and substitution, and recycling above 200 million ounces.
USGS estimates 2025 US silver use at 25% electrical and electronics, 15% photovoltaics, and 18% net physical investment, with 77% net import reliance.

daily_report_items: Confirmed the silver deficit but retained PV substitution, recycling, investment-flow, and issuer-execution gates; no strategy or unverified ticker follow-up was created.
